features: Universal Back navigation is available across BDC Admin HTML screens
Admin sub-screens now include a Dashboard control that returns to the main BDC Admin dashboard
Existing public BDC Home navigation remains separate from Admin Dashboard navigation
Navigation integrates with modern and legacy admin top bars and falls back to a top-right control where needed
JSON, AJAX, judge iframe, download, export and other non-HTML endpoints are excluded from the navigation injection
Hall of Fame and special-category handling from dev64 remain unchanged
Scoring, registration, leaderboard, points, database and Release Manager logic are unchanged
